title: A Survey on Model Compression for Large Language Models
venue: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics
best_for_zh: 为受限部署选择或评估模型压缩方法的读者。
one_line: A TACL survey of quantization, pruning, and distillation for practical LLM deployment.
综述量化、剪枝和知识蒸馏等压缩方法，以及相应的评测指标。
why: It frames compression as a trade-off between resource use and task quality rather than a single speed-up claim.
inclusion_reason: A journal survey of the main ways to make LLMs smaller and cheaper to run while evaluating the trade-offs.

title: Problem
问题
html: Large language models can be too large and computationally demanding for resource-limited deployment. This TACL survey asks how compression methods reduce those costs while preserving enough task quality for a chosen practical use.
大语言模型的体积和计算需求可能让资源受限的部署无法承受。这篇 TACL 综述讨论压缩方法如何降低成本，同时为具体用途保留足够的任务质量。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The survey groups LLM compression around quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation, then places benchmarking and evaluation metrics alongside the methods. Its key reader-facing message is that compression is meaningful only when resource savings and quality are considered together.
综述将大语言模型压缩归纳为量化、剪枝和知识蒸馏，并把基准与评测指标放在方法旁边讨论。它传达的重点是：只有同时考虑资源节省和质量，压缩才有意义。

title: Method
方法
html: This paper synthesizes compression literature rather than introducing one executable pipeline. It explains the major method families and surveys benchmarking strategies and metrics used to assess compressed models, so readers can compare both mechanism and evaluation choice.
论文综合压缩研究，而不是提出一条可直接运行的单一流程。它解释主要方法类别，并综述评估压缩模型时使用的基准策略和指标，让读者同时比较机制与评测选择。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official abstract identifies quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation as the covered method families, and explicitly includes benchmarks and metrics as necessary assessment tools. The paper is a survey, so it should be read as a map of reported results rather than a claim that one method wins everywhere.
官方摘要明确列出量化、剪枝和知识蒸馏，并指出基准与指标是评估的必要工具。它是一篇综述，应被当作已有结果的地图，而不是“某一种方法在所有地方都最好”的结论。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The paper's value is its joint treatment of compression techniques and the evaluation choices needed to judge them. It does not present compression as merely shrinking parameter counts; it connects practical applicability to how efficiency and model behavior are measured.
论文的价值在于同时讨论压缩技术及判断技术效果所需的评测选择。它不把压缩理解成只减少参数量，而是把实际可用性与效率、模型行为的测量方式联系起来。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The best choice depends on the model, hardware, task, and metric, so method comparisons do not automatically transfer across deployment settings. The survey does not release a common compressed checkpoint, dataset, or fixed evaluation suite.
最佳选择取决于模型、硬件、任务和指标，因此方法比较不能自动迁移到另一种部署条件。综述本身不发布统一的压缩模型、数据集或固定评测套件。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this card when a deployment constraint forces you to make a quality-versus-cost decision. It helps readers form a comparison table that includes model size and computation together with the task metrics that matter to their users.
当部署限制迫使你在质量与成本之间取舍时，可使用这张卡。它帮助读者建立比较表，同时记录模型大小、计算消耗和用户真正关心的任务指标。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read each method family with two columns in mind: what resource it saves and what behavior might change. Then check whether the cited evaluation matches your target hardware and task instead of carrying over an efficiency claim without context.

Use the survey as a disciplined comparison guide. First state the deployment constraint: memory, computation, latency, or another resource. Next identify whether quantization, pruning, or knowledge distillation is the mechanism being discussed, and do not infer that their trade-offs are identical. Then place the reported saving beside the task-quality measure used in the cited study. A smaller model can be useful only relative to an intended workload and a stated quality floor. Check whether the benchmark reflects that workload, whether the hardware assumptions match, and whether the evaluation observes the behavior your users need. Keep model size, computational cost, task score, and measurement conditions in the same note. This prevents a result about one practical setting from being recast as a general claim that compression has no meaningful loss.

When comparing two reports, make the comparison conditional rather than absolute. Ask whether they start from comparable base models, use the same resource measure, and test the same task behavior. A reduction in stored parameters is not automatically a reduction in every deployment cost, and a preserved benchmark score does not by itself cover all uses. The survey's method families are useful because they force the reader to name the mechanism before interpreting the result. Record what was changed, what was measured, and what remained outside the measurement. If a paper emphasizes an efficiency number, look for the quality outcome beside it; if it emphasizes task quality, look for the resource budget beside it. This paired reading keeps the decision focused on an explicit trade-off instead of an attractive isolated result.

Finally, decide in advance which outcome would make the method unsuitable. It may be a quality drop on a required task, a resource demand beyond the available setting, or an evaluation that does not represent the intended use. This boundary turns the survey from a list of techniques into a practical selection aid. It also makes a negative result informative: a method can be valuable for one constraint and unsuitable for another without either conclusion being contradictory.

Keep the conclusion narrow: report the method, the resource saved, the quality measure retained, and the setting in which that trade-off was observed. A reader can then decide whether the same trade-off matches a different deployment instead of inheriting a conclusion with its conditions removed.

This final record is also the simplest way to compare later alternatives fairly.

It keeps efficiency claims connected to the task conditions that give them meaning.

阅读每种方法时都记两列：它节省了什么资源，又可能改变什么行为。随后检查引用的评测是否匹配你的硬件和任务，不要脱离条件地照搬效率结论。

可把这篇综述当成严格的比较指南。先写清部署约束：内存、计算量、延迟，还是其他资源；再确认讨论的是量化、剪枝还是知识蒸馏，不能假定它们的取舍完全相同。随后把论文报告的节省与其使用的任务质量指标并列阅读。更小的模型只有相对于目标工作负载和明确质量下限才有意义。应检查基准是否反映该工作负载，硬件假设是否相符，评测是否观察了用户真正需要的行为。把模型大小、计算成本、任务分数和测量条件记在同一处，才能避免把某一实际设置中的结果说成“压缩没有明显损失”的普遍结论。

比较两项报告时，应作有条件的比较，而不是下绝对结论。先问它们是否从可比的基础模型出发、采用同一种资源度量、测试同一种任务行为。存储参数减少并不自动意味着每种部署成本都下降，保住一个基准分数也不代表覆盖所有用途。综述中的方法类别之所以有用，是因为它迫使读者在解读结果前先说清机制。记录改了什么、测了什么、哪些内容没有被测量。若论文突出效率数字，就在旁边寻找质量结果；若突出任务质量，就寻找对应资源预算。这样的配对阅读能让决定围绕明确取舍，而不是被孤立的亮眼结果带走。

最后，应预先决定哪种结果会使该方法不适用：可能是必需任务上的质量下降、超出可用环境的资源需求，或不代表目标用途的评测。这个边界能把综述从技术清单变成实际选择工具，也让负面结果具有信息价值：一种方法可适合某个约束，却不适合另一个约束，二者并不矛盾。

结论也应保持具体：说明采用的方法、节省的资源、保留的质量度量和观察到该取舍的设置。这样读者才能判断同一取舍是否符合另一种部署，而不会继承一个脱离条件的结论。

这份最终记录也是日后公平比较其他方案的最简单基础。

它让效率结论始终与赋予其意义的任务条件相连。

value.html: Surveyed LLM deployment and resource-limited use settings.
Taxonomy of quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, benchmarks, and metrics.
Surveyed primary works; no new training corpus is released.
Practical LLM deployment under size and computational constraints.
Benchmarking strategies and evaluation metrics are compared; no new verifier is introduced.
A compressed model must be assessed against the chosen efficiency and task-quality metrics.
Knowledge distillation is surveyed as a method family; no single teacher is used by the survey.
The official abstract covers quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, benchmarks, and metrics.
Describes compression techniques rather than supplying a new optimizer.
No dataset is released by this survey.
Official ACL Anthology metadata, abstract, DOI, and journal venue reviewed.
